title: Pro Subscription, Performance & Error Handling
description: Introduced Stripe-powered Pro subscriptions with higher AI limits, McMaster-Carr inspired performance optimizations, and improved system-wide error handling.

sections.title: Features
items: **Pro Subscription**: Upgrade to Pro for 900k AI tokens/month (vs 100k free).
**Stripe Integration**: Seamless checkout and subscription management.
**Error Page**: New dedicated error page with clear actions for users.
**Pro Badge**: Visual indicators for Pro users in the navigation bar.

sections.title: Performance
items: **Link Prefetching**: McMaster-Carr style prefetching - route chunks load on hover for instant navigation.
**DNS Prefetch & Preconnect**: Faster loading of external resources (fonts, avatars).
**Font Preloading**: Critical fonts load asynchronously for improved LCP.
**Vendor Chunk Splitting**: Separate bundles for Vue, Charts, and UI libraries for aggressive caching.
**Content Hashing**: All assets use content-based hashes for optimal browser caching.

sections.title: Improvements
items: **Quota System**: Enforced monthly AI token limits with clear error messaging.
**Error Codes**: Standardized error codes for better debugging and UI handling.
**Playwright Testing**: Added E2E tests for error page functionality.
